//: Story Phase 6: the Great Sharkstorm (see src/systems/hazards/sharkstorm.js and src/world/SharkstormLayer.js). One saved story value names its state; the story moves it along. It forms out of the second release and the frenzy, attacks the ship, is driven off by concentrated Frog Grog, and does NOT end: it ends the phase 'active_distant', a rotating storm front on the horizon. No weather simulation; flying sharks on deck are a few pooled sprites, always telegraphed, never harmful (a direct hit knocks the captain flat for a moment). Story Phase 7: it comes BACK (active_distant -> returning -> attacking_ship -> active_near_ship). Not recreated: the same storm, reorganised out of the contamination in the air and the sea and the hundreds of sharks still following the Revenge. It is not driven off again (there is no bulk Frog Grog left to do it with) and ends the phase parked over the ship. Flying sharks come in shapes now (variants); with the crew below, the storm is heard through the deck (below).

returning.//: Story Phase 7: coming back over the horizon. Bigger every time anyone looks. Now and then a shark goes over very high, and the thunder is closer.

active_near_ship.//: Story Phase 7, and the end of it: parked over the ship. Nobody is on deck. Below decks it is heard rather than seen: landings overhead, a scrape, dust from the deckhead.
